tasks.label: Launch Emulator & Install App
tasks.command: if ! adb devices | grep -q 'emulator'; then screen -d -m emulator -avd Pixel_10 -gpu host; echo 'Launching native macOS accelerated emulator...'; fi && adb wait-for-device && echo 'Device detected. Waiting for system boot to finish...' && while [ "$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed | tr -d '\r')" != "1" ]; do sleep 1; done && echo 'Boot complete! Deploying Jetpack Compose App...' && ./gradlew installDebug
